Elian Reviewer Automation Tool

1 source·Oct 20, 2026

The Elian Reviewer is an automated tool driven by NotebookLM designed to streamline the creation of educational materials through an interactive command-line interface. This software assists users by automatically producing various instructional components, including subjects, lessons, and notes, tailored for learning workflows. Additionally, it streamlines assessment preparation by generating practice questions to test comprehension. To ensure technical reliability and data consistency, the platform also incorporates built-in JSON validation features. Overall, this utility serves as a comprehensive solution for educators and learners seeking to automate content creation.

Today • 10:17 PM

Act as a curriculum designer.

Generate a JSON array of subjects for my learning application based on the provided source materials.

Requirements:

  • Generate exactly [INSERT NUMBER] subject(s).
  • Each subject should represent a logical learning module.
  • The "id" must be a short, unique identifier (e.g., "PSI1", "python-basics", "networking-01").
  • The "title" should be concise and descriptive.
  • The "description" should summarize the subject in one or two sentences.

Rules:

  • Return ONLY valid JSON.
  • Do NOT wrap the output in Markdown.
  • Do NOT include explanations or additional text.
  • Do NOT include comments.
  • Follow the schema exactly.

Required JSON Schema:

{{subject.json}}

[ { "id": "elian-cli-automation", "title": "Elian Reviewer CLI & Automation", "description": "Learn how to set up and interact with the Elian Reviewer CLI tool and automate NotebookLM operations." }, { "id": "content-generation-validation", "title": "Reviewer Content Generation & Validation", "description": "Master generating subjects, lessons, notes, and questions with built-in JSON validation." } ]
